import sqlite3

def find_orders(db_path, customer):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer = ?", (customer,))
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    totals = [row[2] for row in rows]
    return sum(totals)
